transformation: Table 4-1 rows were manually transcribed with original Chinese system and unit labels, ISO commissioning dates, rated voltage, rated transfer capacity, line length and grid group.
Back-to-back system totals for sequences 38-44 are sums of the unit ratings printed in Table 4-1; sequences 45-46 retain the table's system-level rating without assigning it to units.
Table 4-5 and Table 4-8 station names were paired in Table 4-1 system order. Sequence 18 terminal names come from the first-party NR Electric project publication.
No converter-station coordinates, line paths or schematic geometry were inferred.

field_scope_notes.rated_voltage: Stored at system level only when the source cell applies to the whole system; otherwise retained on the individual unit.
field_scope_notes.rated_transfer_capacity_mw: A nameplate transfer rating, not observed flow, available capacity, congestion, thermal headroom or real-time dispatch.
field_scope_notes.line_length_km: Reported system line length. Zero is retained for back-to-back systems and does not mean the converter facility has no footprint.
field_scope_notes.terminals: Names only. Terminal order is an index, not a claim about sending/receiving direction.

limitations: This is the NEA's 2024 reliability-management snapshot, published 2025-03-31; it is not a live or exhaustive 2026 grid inventory.
Table 4-1 supplies system facts but no reusable station coordinates or surveyed route geometry. This dataset therefore cannot draw the 51 systems as map lines by itself.

Verified terminal names cover the 37 point-to-point systems. The selected sources do not enumerate terminal rosters for the nine back-to-back and five multi-terminal systems, so those names are not inferred.

Operational reliability, energy-transfer and utilisation metrics are intentionally excluded: they belong to other report tables and contain scope/denominator issues that require a separate audited dataset.
The source report is not redistributed. This repository stores a factual transcription, source URLs, page references and the verified PDF SHA-256 digest.
